notes.title: Backrooms: Reminiscence - Announcement
notes.notes:
I'm glad to announce that I have started working on my next game, [b]Backrooms: Reminiscence[/b]. It's a sequel to [b]Backrooms: Exploration[/b]. The game is going to be focused on 2 main characters: [b]John Sherpardson[/b] (AKA the other robber) and [b]William Smith[/b]. I plan to add a lot of story and lore to this game as well.

It will be my last [b]Backrooms[/b] game, and I will make sure it's much better than my previous two games. This game will feature much more than [b]Backrooms: Exploration[/b] did. I plan to make almost everything interactable, since it feels the most realistic way to do a good [b]Backrooms[/b] game. I'm not sure about entities yet, but I feel like they won't be in a big role in this game. That's it for now, I'll keep you updated throughout the development phase!

Go follow me on X for teasers and sneak peeks: [url=https://x.com/Hoogan3D]HNStudios Official X[/url]

Thanks for all the support that I've gotten, you keep me motivated!

notes.title: Full Release Update
notes.notes:
Full Release is finally here!

Here's everything what has changed:

- 5 new levels
- Better settings and optimization
- New mode where you can turn off hostile entities
- New game mode "The Nightmare"

Here's what I removed:
- Combination lock puzzle
- Some voice lines

notes.title: Backrooms: Exploration – Full Release Trailer - May 2nd
Backrooms: Exploration - Full Release Info
notes.notes:
The full release for [b]Backrooms: Exploration[/b] isn't too far away. Everything is going as planned, and I'd like to announce a few things that will be added in the full release. 

The release date hasn't been confirmed yet, but I'd say it's somewhere around May.

- 5 New Levels
- Better Optimization
- New Game Mode: "[b]The Nightmare[/b]"

And maybe a game mode where there are 0 entities.

Stay tuned,
HNStudios

notes.title: Backrooms: Exploration – Available Now on Steam
notes.notes:
[b]Backrooms: Exploration[/b] is now available on Steam. Two friends have lost their jobs due to COVID-19, but they still have to bring food to the table. After a failed heist, one of them ends up in the Backrooms. Now your only mission is to survive.

Explore the backrooms, solve puzzles, and find a way to escape—if possible.

🔗 Get it now on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423660/Backrooms_Exploration/]Backrooms: Exploration[/url]

Join the community and share your experiences.

Welcome to the Backrooms. Try not to get lost.
